resources.string: Demonstrates ToolManager: activate/deactivate/isActive against a hidden, overlay-only demo tool, and observe activeTools live.

Manage a hidden demo tool from here. It has no catalog entry and no window of its own — its only surface is a small badge overlaid on the shared map. Activate it, deactivate it, and watch the live active-tools list update in real time. Because the demo tool\'s required component is an overlay, not a window, activating it never covers this screen: this window and its buttons stay usable the whole time.
